intended_surface: Public GitHub portfolio Power BI dashboard

direct_patient_identifiers.evidence: No patient identifier columns or row-level encounter data

provider_identifiers.evidence: No NPI values, names, or provider-level rows; only allowlisted aggregate counts

facility_identifiers.evidence: No facility IDs, names, addresses, or facility-level rows

granular_dates_or_geography.evidence: Quarter/year project coverage only; no encounter date or granular geography

private_filesystem_paths.evidence: Dashboard-facing outputs use relative logical paths only

credentials_or_private_urls.evidence: No credential, token, email, or private URL fields

row_level_research_data.evidence: Tables contain project metadata and fictional aggregate demonstration values only

unapproved_analytical_estimates.evidence: No coefficients, confidence intervals, p-values, q-values, or result tables

unsupported_completion_claims.evidence: Phase 1 completion is separated from unfinished Phase 2 and final audit

synthetic_data_labeling.evidence: Every synthetic row has SyntheticFlag=true and SYNTHETIC_PUBLIC_SAFE classification

race_measurement_language.evidence: Full-name probabilistic proxy; no geography; not BISG; not self-reported

causal_language.evidence: Dashboard is explicitly observational and association-focused

excluded_by_design: Raw or processed Florida encounter rows
